newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: LITHUANIA-NOMURA SAYS BIRZAI DAIRY'S PROSPECTS GOOD.
newsitem.headline: LITHUANIA-NOMURA SAYS BIRZAI DAIRY'S PROSPECTS GOOD.

text.p: An analyst from international investment bank Nomura said on Thursday that she was positive over the future prospects for Birzai Dairy, one of the blue chips on the Vilnius bourse.
"Our opinion of Birzai Dairy remains extremely positive," Nomura's east European analyst Frances Cloud told Reuters.
Cloud said she was visiting the company to update its information on its activities.
"The prospects of the company are very good because Birzai is the strongest of the fresh product dairies in Lithuania," Cloud added.
The director general of Birzhai Dairy Vladas Songaila told Reuters that Nomura represented the interests of foreign investors in the company.
The company is 69 percent-owned by foreign investors and was the first Baltic corporate to launch a $6 million global depository receipts (GDR) last December.
The company said earlier its net profit in 1996 was 2.2 million litas and the first quarter net profit rose to 1.1 million litas versus 270,000 litas in the same period last year.
Birzhai Dairy has applied to be included on the official trading list of Vilnius bourse on Monday.
